description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Salvager of Secrets.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, adding {B}.
When Salvager of Secrets dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
